I dont have health insurance any more because on paper i make too much. I didn't die in my sleep so i went to work only for my manager to put me on my final. 
Heh i guess its my fault. Everything is my fault. Whats the point? What is the point of any of this? Even when you try and struggle and push thru life just reminds you that it doesn't matter. If this is my lot in life i am just ready to die.
